summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a Form 6-K to announce a change in its ADS-to-ordinary-share ratio from 1:3 to 1:60, effective May 11, 2026, with the same effect as a 1-for-20 reverse ADS split. The ordinary shares are unaffected; no shares are issued or canceled. This non-standard filing is a routine corporate action to adjust the ADS price to meet Nasdaq's minimum bid requirement for continued listing. It does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 provides further details. There is no deal activity; the action is mechanical.
